completed.goal_open: {minutes} minutes. {left} more to your daily goal.

completed.practice_done: Well done. This is how the end of a session sounds and feels.

aborted.title: Session stopped
aborted.heading: Your session stopped at {time}.
aborted.hidden: Your session stopped at {time} because Rewarded was no longer on your screen. You kept going for {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}. Stopped sessions earn no points: we can only reward time we can see. Your squad streak is still running.
aborted.heartbeat_gap: Your session stopped at {time} because we got no signal from your device for longer than allowed. That can be the wifi. You kept going for {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}. Is this wrong? A person checks whether we can restore your session.
aborted.user_stop: You stopped after {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}. A 25-minute session also counts for your daily goal.
aborted.second_session: You started a session on another device, so this one stopped. One runs at a time.
aborted.late_end: The end of your session reached us late, with no signal in between. That is why this session does not count. Is this wrong? A person checks whether we can restore it.
aborted.third: Hard to keep going today? Try 25 minutes with Do Not Disturb on.
aborted.unconfirmed: We are still waiting for the server to confirm; that happens once you are online.
aborted.practice_note: This is what a stopped session looks like. Practice does not count anywhere.

report.title: Is this wrong?
report.hidden: A call, another app or a screen that turned off cannot be undone: we no longer saw Rewarded on your screen. Your report helps us decide whether a short return window comes after the pilot.
report.user_stop: You stopped yourself; that cannot be undone. Did you stop by accident? Let us know, and we will see whether the stop button can be better.
report.second_session: A session started on another device. Was that not you? Report it, and a person looks at your account, usually within 3 working days.
report.heartbeat_gap: A person checks whether we can restore your session, usually within 3 working days. That is possible if we had an outage or if your device still sent a valid log.
report.late_end: A person checks whether we can restore your session, usually within 3 working days. That is possible if we had an outage or if your device still sent a valid log.

choices.screen_off: The screen turned off by itself
choices.not_me: I did not start another session

report.sent_hidden: Thanks. Your report counts towards that decision.

report.sent_review: Your report is in. You see its status under Me, Reports.

how.title: How we count
how.claim: Rewarded counts your focus time as long as the app is open and visible on your screen. If you go to another app or tab, or your screen turns off, the session stops.
how.rule_lengths: A session lasts 25, 50 or 90 minutes. There is no pause: if you want a break, finish and start again.
how.rule_server: The duration comes from our server, not from your device's clock.
how.rule_offline: If the connection drops, your session keeps running. If the connection is gone for more than 5 minutes, the session stops at the last moment we saw you.
how.rule_day: Your day runs from 04:00 to 04:00. A session counts for the day it started.
how.rule_night: A session that starts between 01:00 and 04:00 counts, but without the goal bonus.
how.rule_laptop: On a laptop you may work in another window, as long as the tab stays visible.
how.code_hidden: Rewarded was no longer on your screen.
how.code_heartbeat_gap: We got no signal from your device for a while.
how.code_second_session: You started a session on another device.
how.code_late_end: Your end reached us too late.
how.unseen: We cannot see whether you use a second device, nor whether you really study. That is why we give points and small rewards, not money.
how.report_body: After a stopped session you can report that it is wrong. A person can only restore a session if we had an outage or if your device still sent a valid log. A call or another app cannot be undone.
